dedupe_keys.name: eurostat hospital beds by function and type of care hlth rs bds1

description: This dataset gives the number of hospital beds in European countries by function and type of care, compiled by Eurostat from national health statistics authorities through the joint questionnaire on non-monetary health care statistics shared with the OECD and WHO Europe. It reports available beds in hospitals split into curative, rehabilitative, long-term and other care, and by somatic and psychiatric care, as absolute numbers, per 100,000 inhabitants and inhabitants per bed. Coverage is the EU member states and other reporting European countries annually, with the longest series reaching back to 1960 and the latest year 2025; the table was last updated in July 2026. Data are free to browse and download as CSV, TSV or Excel or through the Eurostat JSON and SDMX API, reusable under the Eurostat copyright notice with attribution. Caveats: definitions of hospital beds and care types differ between countries and change over time, breaks in series are common, and the figures are national totals without facility locations or occupancy. Simulation uses: setting national bed capacity baselines for hospital surge and pandemic scenarios, comparing capacity per head across countries, and calibrating healthcare capacity models. Related records: US community hospital beds by state (data-dqs-community-hospital-beds-by-state-united-states-p02628) and Italian hospital beds by structure (data-italy-hospital-beds-by-structure-2010-2017) give comparable figures at finer scale.
